content: Abstract The report, titled "Competitive and Market Intelligence for Aiguille Security," provides a comprehensive analysis of the security services landscape in South Africa, highlighting key competitive dynamics, technological differentiators, client sector trends, and the regulatory and operational frameworks shaping the market. The analysis begins by examining the competitive environment, identifying major integrated security providers and their core service lines. This section offers valuable insights into market leaders and niche players, presenting a detailed overview of the security industry’s structural composition and service diversity.
